The sum of the interior angles is (n−2)·180°. The missing angle x satisfies 0 < x < 180°, so 1070 < (n−2)·180 < 1250. This gives 5.94 < n−2 < 6.94, so n−2 = 6 and n = 8. The total is then 1440°, and the missing angle is 1440° − 1070° = 370°, which is not less than 180°. I rechecked: (n−2)·180 with n = 8 is 6·180 = 1080°, not 1440°. So the total is 1080° and x = 10°, which is valid.

Solution A makes an arithmetic error. For n = 6 the total is 720°, so x = 720 − 1070 = −350°, which is impossible. Its answer of 6 is wrong.

Solution B reaches 8 using only the upper bound on x. It skips checking that x > 0, but n = 8 does satisfy it, so the answer is correct.

WINNER: B
